args.title: Fix the time calculation issue for the weekly summary email
args.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

Investigate and correct the `localHour` function, which is used in the `isRollupDue` function, to properly handle non-whole-hour time zones. The current implementation might not correctly calculate local time for users in such zones, causing the rollup to be sent at incorrect times.

label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The weekly summary arrives at 08:30 instead of 08:00 due to how the `localHour` function handles non-whole-hour time zones. The logic in `isRollupDue` needs adjustment for these edge cases.
